proves.claim: clause 1: the verify table admits a builder accept when every solo low-stakes condition holds and the item records its tree, and writes a solo-low-stakes-accept event after the accept event naming the verdict id, commit, tree, digest and verifier.

moves.table-verify.solo-accept-event.why: Without the event the verified proof trigger refuses a builder's own accept NOT_PROVEN, so the solo rule could never take effect (#966, #11344).

proves.claim: clause 2: an accept by a verifier who is not an author writes no solo-low-stakes-accept event, and a builder accept where any solo condition fails is still refused SELF_VERIFY with no events.

moves.table-verify.no-solo-event-indepen.why: The solo event must exist only for a real solo accept, so an independent review leaves the record unchanged and a failed solo condition keeps the independence rule (#966).
